title: Nuclear Fission
description: A slow neutron splits a uranium-235 nucleus into two lighter ones, freeing 200 MeV and two or three new neutrons. If on average exactly one of them splits another nucleus, the reaction keeps itself going. Unlocks the Molten Salt Reactor.

puzzle.goal: A neutron from one splitting nucleus makes η new neutrons per neutron the fuel absorbs; a fraction f of slowed neutrons are absorbed by fuel, a fraction p survive slowing down, and fast splits add a factor ε. Write k, the neutrons in the next generation per neutron in this one.
puzzle.name: Four-factor formula
puzzle.ask: Find k for a graphite core: n = @{n}, f = @{f}, p = @{p}, e = @{e}.
puzzle.method: Follow one generation round: each step keeps or multiplies the neutron count, so the factors multiply.
